name: Jabor
description: Jabor was a planet where Ferus Olin worked for the Galactic Republic during the Clone Wars. Ferus sent double agent Clive Flax undercover into the local Separatist base, thus disrupting a spy ring that had taken root throughout the Mid Rim. Its subsequent destruction saved many lives.
